inlines.text: 个人智能体协议
（Personal Agent Protocol，简称 Poppy）自我们上月与首批设计合作伙伴 Meta、Genesys、Instinct、NiCE、Rocket、Shopify、Stripe 和 Walmart 共同发布这一新标准以来，已经获得了实实在在的进展。Poppy 让个人智能体能够通过企业智能体、网站和 API 与企业互动。今天我们很高兴地宣布：
协议的 v1.0 版本
现已发布
Shopify 已为其平台上的所有商家启用 Poppy。
多个设计合作伙伴正在正式上线 Poppy，包括 Mercury、Synchrony 和土耳其航空。
所有使用 Muse（Meta 的 AI 智能体）的用户现在都能用上 Poppy，Muse 在访问每个网站时都会自动优先查找 Poppy。
60 家新公司作为设计合作伙伴加入，使总数超过 100 家，包括

Affirm、Aflac、Agoda、Aircall、Akoya、Aviva、Banco Sabadell、Braze、Browserbase、Checkout.com、Cisco、Cover Genius、Creditas、Crunch Fitness、Cue、达美航空、Descope、EarnIn、Five9、Freshworks、Fullstory、Gen Digital、Global Payments、GoFundMe、GoodRx、Guardian、HealthEx、HelloFresh、凯悦、Infoblox、Intuit、Kernel、Kin Insurance、Lemonade、Liberty Global、Manus、Mercury、Navy Federal Credit Union、Neptune Flood、Ora、Persona、Pindrop、Ping Identity、Profound、Prosus、Remitly、Runlayer、Salesforce（包括 Fin、Commerce Cloud 和 Agentforce）、Socure、SoFi、Symphony by Wix、The Knot、The Zebra、Travelers、土耳其航空、Twilio、Wayfair、Wix、WorkOS 和 Zoom。

blocks.text: Poppy v1.0

inlines.text: Poppy v1.0

blocks.text: Poppy 1.0 版体现了设计合作伙伴过去五周在真实网站、API 和智能体上测试草案所积累的经验。

inlines.text: Poppy 1.0 版体现了设计合作伙伴过去五周在真实网站、API 和智能体上测试草案所积累的经验。

blocks.text: 该协议定义了个人智能体如何与实施它的企业建立连接，让智能体能够清晰、全面地访问企业提供的各项服务，其构建主要基于 MCP、OpenAPI 和 UCP 等现有标准。通过 OAuth 进行身份验证，客户可以控制个人智能体能做什么、不能做什么，并可以随时管理这些权限。

inlines.text: 该协议定义了个人智能体如何与实施它的企业建立连接，让智能体能够清晰、全面地访问企业提供的各项服务，其构建主要基于 MCP、OpenAPI 和 UCP 等现有标准。通过 OAuth 进行身份验证，客户可以控制个人智能体能做什么、不能做什么，并可以随时管理这些权限。

blocks.text: 自初版草案以来，我们：

inlines.text: 自初版草案以来，我们：
让企业更容易分阶段采用该协议，从基础功能起步，逐步增加能力；
完善了协议对现有标准的使用方式；
扩展了企业向个人智能体提供指引、收集反馈的能力；
引入了扩展机制，例如由 Shopify 共同编写的商务扩展，让各行业可以在核心协议之上构建，而无需改动协议本身。

blocks.text: 借助 v1.0，任何企业都可以自行实施 Poppy，并立即为使用 Muse 的客户带来更好的体验。我们的实施工具包会引导你完成设置，并附带一个验证器来检查你的工作。

blocks.text: Sierra 和 Shopify 将 Poppy 带给数百万商家

inlines.text: Sierra 和 Shopify 将 Poppy 带给数百万商家

blocks.text: Shopify 为 175 多个国家的企业提供服务，每个 Shopify 商店默认支持通用商务协议（UCP）。随着越来越多的购物行为转向个人智能体，现在每个 Shopify 商店都会自动发布 Poppy 文件，商家无需做任何额外实施。

inlines.text: Shopify 为 175 多个国家的企业提供服务，每个 Shopify 商店默认支持通用商务协议（UCP）。随着越来越多的购物行为转向个人智能体，现在每个 Shopify 商店都会自动发布 Poppy 文件，商家无需做任何额外实施。

blocks.text: UCP 与 Poppy 相辅相成。UCP 负责购物本身，比如查找商品、加入购物车和结账；Poppy 则负责在此之前发生的事：当智能体来到商店时，表明自己的身份，并了解自己可以做什么。

inlines.text: UCP 与 Poppy 相辅相成。UCP 负责购物本身，比如查找商品、加入购物车和结账；Poppy 则负责在此之前发生的事：当智能体来到商店时，表明自己的身份，并了解自己可以做什么。

blocks.text: Shopify 联合编写了 Poppy 的商务扩展，把这两个协议连接起来。它让智能体既能以访客身份购物，也能用客户账号登录；在执行某些操作前，它会要求智能体先征询客户意见，因此智能体只在获得客户许可后才行动。它还能接入 UCP Ask，让购物者的智能体直接与商店的智能体对话。

blocks.text: Poppy 的实际应用

inlines.text: Poppy 的实际应用

blocks.text: 目前已有多家企业上线使用 Poppy：

inlines.text: 目前已有多家企业上线使用 Poppy：
Mercury 让个人智能体打理财务：
使用 Mercury 办理企业及个人银行业务的用户，现在可以让自己的个人智能体查询余额、查看近期交易、对支出分类，或及时更新预算和收据。客户甚至可以要求个人智能体发起付款或转账，Mercury 会确保请求先通过账户的审批策略，然后才会发出。
Synchrony 将把分期与奖励带入智能体主导的购物：
这项合作探索个人智能体如何帮助客户找到合适的产品，同时兼顾可负担性以及相关的 Synchrony 优惠和分期产品。假以时日，这可能为 Synchrony 的能力开辟新途径，融入其覆盖超过 50 万个商户网点的购物体验。
土耳其航空从搜索到商务舱全程欢迎个人智能体：
个人智能体现在可以查询票价、航班状态和中转停留信息，还能凭预订编号和姓氏调出预订记录。Miles&Smiles 会员甚至可以让智能体查找商务舱升舱选项，由客户在付款前确认。目前公司正努力让会员无需离开对话即可完成购买。

blocks.text: 我们非常感谢所有为这一新标准做出贡献的公司，也期待欢迎更多企业加入我们的设计合作。随着个人智能体承担越来越多日常事务，企业需要清晰、安全的方式与它们协作，同时继续提供值得信赖的体验。Poppy 为他们提供了这一基础——让企业与个人智能体能够为他们共同的客户把事情办好。

inlines.text: Poppy v1.0

blocks.text: Version 1.0 of Poppy reflects what design partners have learned over the past five weeks as they’ve tested the drafts against real websites, APIs, and agents.

inlines.text: Version 1.0 of Poppy reflects what design partners have learned over the past five weeks as they’ve tested the drafts against real websites, APIs, and agents.

blocks.text: The protocol defines how personal agents connect with companies that implement it, providing clear and comprehensive access to everything they offer, largely built with existing standards like MCP, OpenAPI, and UCP. With authentication through OAuth, customers control what personal agents can and can’t do, and can manage their access over time.

blocks.text: Since the initial draft, we’ve:

inlines.text: Since the initial draft, we’ve:
Made it easier for companies to adopt the protocol in stages, starting with the basics and adding capabilities over time;
Refined how the protocol uses existing standards;
Expanded a company’s ability to provide guidance and collect feedback from the personal agent;
Introduced extensions, such as the commerce extension co-authored by Shopify, so industries can build on the core protocol without changing it.

blocks.text: With v1.0, any company can implement Poppy on its own and immediately start delivering a better experience for customers who use Muse. Our implementation kit walks you through setup and includes a validator to check your work.

blocks.text: Sierra and Shopify bring Poppy to millions of merchants

inlines.text: Sierra and Shopify bring Poppy to millions of merchants

blocks.text: Shopify powers businesses in more than 175 countries, and every Shopify store supports Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) by default. As more shopping moves to personal agents, every Shopify store now automatically publishes a Poppy file, so merchants don’t need to do any extra implementation.

inlines.text: Shopify powers businesses in more than 175 countries, and every Shopify store supports Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) by default. As more shopping moves to personal agents, every Shopify store now automatically publishes a Poppy file, so merchants don’t need to do any extra implementation.

blocks.text: UCP and Poppy complement each other. UCP handles the shopping itself, like finding products, filling a cart, and checking out. Poppy handles what happens before that, when an agent shows up at a store, says who it is, and finds out what it’s allowed to do.

inlines.text: UCP and Poppy complement each other. UCP handles the shopping itself, like finding products, filling a cart, and checking out. Poppy handles what happens before that, when an agent shows up at a store, says who it is, and finds out what it’s allowed to do.

blocks.text: Shopify co-authored Poppy’s commerce extension, which links the two protocols. It lets an agent shop as a guest or sign in with the customer’s account, and it makes the agent ask the customer before taking certain actions, so it only acts with their permission. It also connects to UCP Ask, so a shopper’s agent can talk directly to the store’s agent.

blocks.text: A number of businesses are now live with Poppy:

inlines.text: A number of businesses are now live with Poppy:
Mercury puts personal agents to work on finances:

People who use Mercury for business and personal banking can now ask their personal agent to check balances, review recent transactions, categorize spending, or keep budgets and receipts up to date. Customers can even ask their personal agent to initiate a payment or transfer, with Mercury ensuring the request goes through the account’s approval policy before anything is sent.
Synchrony will bring financing and rewards into agent-led shopping:

The work explores how a personal agent could help customers find the right product while considering affordability and relevant Synchrony offers and financing products along the way. Over time, that could create new ways to bring Synchrony capabilities into shopping experiences across their network of more than 500,000 merchant locations.
Turkish Airlines welcomes personal agents from search to business class

: Personal agents can now check out fares, flight status, and stopovers, as well as pull up a booking with a reference number and surname. Miles&Smiles members can even have their agent find business-class upgrades, which customers approve before paying. It’s now working to let members complete a purchase without leaving the conversation.

blocks.text: Choice, control, trust

inlines.text: Choice, control, trust

blocks.text: We’re so grateful to all the companies that are contributing to this new standard, and excited to welcome more to our design partnership. As personal agents take on more of our everyday tasks, companies need clear, secure ways to work with them while continuing to deliver a trusted experience. Poppy gives them that foundation — so the company and the personal agent can get the job done for the customer they share.
